description: Implementation of ProductDao, providing database access methods for Product entities within the sales management system. Contains methods for retrieving products by semantic URL, locale, categories, tax class, store, ID, code, and with pagination, often involving complex JPQL queries with multiple fetch joins.

classes.name: ProductDaoImpl
classes.description: Data Access Object implementation for Product, providing methods to retrieve and list products based on various criteria, often involving complex JPQL queries with multiple fetch joins.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its SEO-friendly URL within a specific store and locale, using JPQL with multiple fetch joins to load related entities.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Returns a list of products available in a specific store and locale, filtered by category IDs, language, and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Fetches products belonging to specified categories, with optional filtering by language and availability, using fetch joins.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories (overload)
methods.description: Similar to the above but with additional filtering by language, also supporting pagination.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class, using fetch joins.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all products belonging to a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore (with criteria)
methods.description: Lists products in a store with advanced filtering based on product criteria, including pagination and count filtering.

methods.name: getProductsListForLocale
methods.description: Private helper to retrieve a localized subset of products for category listings, with limited fetch joins for performance optimization.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a specific product by ID for a given locale, with fetch joins to load related data.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its database ID, fully loading related entities.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its SKU code, fully loading related entities.
